feeds.title: FemTechnology Summit Blog
feeds.description: FemTechnology Summit Blog is about women's health care, offering articles on cancer care, gender therapy, financing health care, and more.

feeds.title: Femtech Insider
feeds.description: Femtech Insider is the go-to platform and globally leading media outlet for all things femtech and women's health innovation. We're the largest and fastest-growing online publication in our space and address the information needs of founders, investors, researchers, and consumers interested in this space.

feeds.title: FemTech World
feeds.description: FemTech World is a health technology magazine. It has articles, news, opinions, features, insights, and more.

feeds.title: Joylux Blog
feeds.description: Joylux offers a platform of life-changing solutions with high-tech devices, digital tools, and products that address intimate health concerns. By combining science-based products with access to education, health data, and community, we strive to deliver better health outcomes. Our mission is to help women find delight in their lives, from motherhood to menopause.

feeds.title: Med-Tech Insights » FemTech
feeds.description: Read articles about femtech products and more. As the leading multi-platform communication brand for the UK and Irish medical design and manufacturing industries, partnering with us will take your message to an exclusive and influential audience of prospects, current customers, and future collaborators through an unrivaled mix of print, digital and live platforms, built on years of expertise.

feeds.title: FemTech Analytics Blog
feeds.description: FemTech Analytics is one of the specialized analytical subsidiaries of Deep Knowledge Group focused on the FemTech sector. Deep Knowledge Group is a data-driven consortium of commercial and non-profit organizations active on many fronts in the realm of DeepTech and Frontier Technologies (AI, Longevity, BioTech, Pharma, FinTech, GovTech, SpaceTech, FemTech, Data Science, InvestTech), ranging from scientific research to investment, entrepreneurship, analytics, consulting, media, philanthropy and more.

feeds.title: Ema
feeds.description: Ema is your empathetic AI companion, designed to support you on your journey through femalehood. From fertility to menopause, Ema is like your BFF who became your OBGYN, connecting you to the friends you need and offering the wellness support you can trust. Built using GPT, the latest in AI deep learning, Ema provides personalized assistance, resources, and answers to make your life healthier and happier.

feeds.title: Oya Femtech Apparel Blog
feeds.description: OYA Women's Apparel celebrates women's bodies with workout clothes that are ventilated, anti-microbial and OB/GYN tested to protect your vaginal health through every stage of life.

feeds.title: LactApp Blog
feeds.description: LactApp is the first app dedicated to breastfeeding and maternity that solves your doubts in a personalized way. Our mission is to facilitate the role of women as a force for change in society.

feeds.title: GWHIC Blog
feeds.description: Global Women's Health Innovation Conference 2022 is a two-day high-impact conference and a showcase of the challenges and opportunities in advancing women's health and the role of technology and innovation to improve healthcare and make healthcare equity a reality. The conference will focus on digital innovations and the emerging future of femtech, what is next in healthcare, and how to accelerate innovation and investment in femtech.

feeds.title: The FemTech Revolution Blog
feeds.description: The FemTech Revolution is New Zealand's first and only FemTech marketplace. Our mission is to bring amazing FemTech innovations to the women of New Zealand. We provide science-backed innovations and tools from around the world to support women's health throughout life. We want to support women to step up and take care of themselves, of their bodies, of their health!

feeds.title: Fermata Singapore Blog
feeds.description: Our hormonal changes combined with the ignition of our sexual desires should be a cause for celebration and pride. Instead, we often find ourselves confronted with self-doubt, shame, and tough questions. We include male and gender-queer folks in the discussion because when it comes to fertility, parenthood, and relationships, it often takes two to tango.

feeds.title: Emerging Femtech Blog
feeds.description: Emerging Femtech is a new virtual event series that aims to highlight and foster dialogue on the vital role of innovation in advancing women's health. In addition to in-depth discussions with industry experts, Emerging Femtech aims to provide attendees with insights into careers in entrepreneurship and venture capital and to facilitate valuable networking opportunities.

feeds.title: Hormona.io
feeds.description: Hormona was created by women, for women, with their hormone health at its heart. We're supported by leading endocrinologists, gynecologists, and nutritionists, meaning the combined knowledge behind Hormona is unrivaled, and puts your health in the safest of hands. And by focusing on data and cutting-edge research, we can also help every woman better understand and live with balanced hormones every day. Our mission is to provide women with the tools and information they need to take control of their hormone health.

feeds.title: The Oova Blog
feeds.description: The OOVA fertility tracker provides lab-quality readings that accurately decode your hormones and give you personalized steps to get pregnant.

feeds.title: Amboy Street Ventures Blog
feeds.description: Amboy Street Ventures invests in startups that are creating the vital technology that meets the Sexual Health and Women's Health needs of our progressive society. We are dedicated to the growth of Sexual Health & Women's Health Technology startups.

feeds.title: Coyote Ventures Blog
feeds.description: We are a venture capital fund investing in early-stage startups that are innovating women's health & wellness. Read our blog posts related to the funding of women's healthcare startups.

feeds.title: Teal Health Blog
feeds.description: Teal Health is on a mission to provide women with the tools and resources they need to make their own, empowered decisions regarding their health-starting with cervical cancer screenings. We are on a mission to get all women screened for cervical cancer.

feeds.title: Hertility Health Limited Blog
feeds.description: We help women take control of their health and make informed decisions about their future. Our blog with articles and information on topics relating to fertility and reproductive health. By bringing reproductive science out of the lab and into the hands of every single woman worldwide, we're setting a new standard of scientific rigour and education in female health to nurture the Mother of all movements - one powered by a new generation of women who back their bodies and their life choices.
